data.description:
Each target recovers an amount of @DATA[key.resourceLocal] equal to 【10 + twice your current Willpower die size】. This amount increases by 10 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 20 if you are level 40 or higher.

If this verse causes MP recovery, it has no effect on the character that sings it.

Targets Recover: @GAIN[($wlp*2)+&step(10,20,30) @DATA[key.resource]]{Recover @DATA[key.resourceLocal]}
